reason: I'd sign up for the free 100 conversations and sit on it for months. I only pay when a limit forces me, and I'd want to read G2 or Capterra reviews first, which a new product probably doesn't have yet.
objection: Another monthly subscription for something visitors might ignore. I have no proof yet that a mascot lifts sign-ups on a kids' app, and the price is trivial next to the time it takes me to vet it and the brand and child-safety risk of an AI talking to kids.
would_change_my_mind: Free-tier A/B data on my own site showing a clear sign-up lift, plus a handful of independent reviews on G2 or Capterra from edtech or kids' products, and a clear statement of how it handles minors' data.
